final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS h, SUM(sc.scancount) AS s, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS a FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1) SELECT s1.h, s1.s, s1.a, s1.a - s2.m FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL
